sources.title: Digital Daijisen: 闇堕ち
sources.claim_scope: Lexical definition only: a formerly good-side character strays to the evil side in a story.

sources.title: [이전] 모에리뷰- 흑화편
sources.claim_scope: Korean fan reception, before/after contrast, and broad trope boundaries; not a representative survey.

sources.title: [모에 리뷰] 흑화 편 [2]
sources.claim_scope: Fan taxonomy of coercion, possession, awakening, despair, and other causes; definitions are explicitly non-universal.

sources.title: 悪堕ちと闇堕ちの違いとは？
sources.claim_scope: Specialist fandom distinction between passive and active corruption; useful as tagging practice, not authoritative language law.

sources.title: Inducing narrative tension in the viewer through suspense, surprise, and curiosity
sources.claim_scope: General narrative-structure evidence: suspense, surprise, and curiosity structures induce tension, and local tension relates positively to overall enjoyment; not trope-specific appeal proof.

sources.title: NTRマンガにおける『不能性』の表現
sources.publisher: 日本マンガ学会 第23回大会 abstracts
sources.claim_scope: Dates the NTR label to the early 2000s in bishoujo-game context and analyzes the displaced protagonist/player as unable to intervene or only able to watch.

sources.title: 寝取る
sources.claim_scope: Lexical verb: to have relations with another person's spouse or lover and make that person one's own; does not define the later NTR genre viewpoint.

sources.title: NTR（寝取られ）用語辞典
sources.claim_scope: Fan-facing distinction among netorare, netori, reverse NTR, and netorase; not academic or universally standardized.

sources.title: [모에토의] NTR에 대한 잡담 [3]
sources.claim_scope: Korean fan discussion of prior bonds, plausibility, discovery, reaction, and viewpoint; anecdotal and not population evidence.

sources.title: 令和最大のヒット萌え『BSS』を知ってますか？
sources.claim_scope: Editorial history and usage of BSS, short for 僕が先に好きだったのに; distinguishes unrealized earlier affection from an established-partner loss.

sources.title: The Effects of Relationship and Self-Esteem Threats on the Likelihood of Romantic Jealousy
sources.publisher: Journal of Social and Personal Relationships
sources.claim_scope: Relationship threat and self-esteem threat both affect jealousy likelihood and related emotions; does not establish NTR enjoyment.

sources.title: サブカルチャーにおける主体の生成変化：アイテという倫理消費様式
sources.claim_scope: Traces an early use to Urusei Yatsura vol.14 (1982) and analyzes the modern pattern of insolence, repeated insults, downward stance, and a passive counterpart. The 1982 citation is an early word use, not proof that the complete modern archetype existed then.

sources.title: メスガキ (JMdict 2858101)
sources.claim_scope: Marks the noun as slang and vulgar; supports a boundary from generic sass or mischievousness.

sources.title: [모에토의] 메스가키는 왜 유행하는가? [2]
sources.claim_scope: Fan discussion of target-directed provocation, moderated cuteness, reverse embarrassment, and abrasive-but-caring variants; not representative preference evidence.

sources.title: 疑似母性（バブみ）を表出する発話機能付き膝枕型ロボットの開発
sources.claim_scope: Documents babumi as mid-2010s internet slang, distinguishes indulgent warmth from practical care, and reports lap pillow, hug, and nursing as direct visual motifs in a 2018 Pixiv-tag sample; the sample and small experiment are not universal preference rankings.

sources.title: 『萌え』の派生として話題の『バブみ』とは？
sources.claim_scope: Records competing internet usages: feeling motherly care from an unexpected or younger figure versus finding the target baby-like and wanting to care for them; the two directions should not be silently merged.

sources.title: [모에리뷰] 모성애/마망 편
sources.claim_scope: Korean fandom vocabulary and role-reversal discussion; not a general psychological finding.

sources.title: 委員会活動（2025年度 各委員会の委員長による紹介）
sources.claim_scope: Current real-school example: lost-property management, school-badge checks, greeting activities, and ICT/terminal management.

sources.title: 学校新聞にみる戦後初期の立命館高等学校の自治活動 後編
sources.claim_scope: Single-school historical evidence that a 1948 morals committee assisted teachers with everyday student-management rules; not a national origin claim.

sources.title: [모에설명] 풍기위원편
sources.claim_scope: Korean fan contrast between limited real duties and exaggerated fictional authority, plus tidy uniform/armband and composure-gap conventions.

sources.title: 間違えたら戦になる『TSF』／pixivタグ検隊
sources.claim_scope: Describes TSF as a Japanese-web umbrella for transformation fiction/fantasy including same-person bodily change, reciprocal swap, possession, and brain transfer, while noting fuzzy tag boundaries.

sources.title: Redefining genderswap fan fiction: A Sherlock case study
sources.claim_scope: Shows that genderswap labels can minimize bodily and gender-identity complexity and should not be treated as equivalent to real transgender identity or as a single uniform transformation.

sources.title: Yandere
sources.claim_scope: Anime character who first seems pleasant or kind and whose loving devotion becomes unpleasant, unkind, violent, or destructive; usually but not exclusively female.

sources.title: ヤンデレ - ニコニコ動画用語辞典（旧ページ）
sources.claim_scope: Early fan-era description linking affection, a trigger, and a subsequent destructive or unstable state; explicitly notes that the fandom definition is not fixed.

sources.title: Between Love and Obsession: Japanese Society's Perspective on the Concept of Yandere Characters
sources.claim_scope: Survey of 15 interested Japanese anime/manga respondents; documents mixed reactions, with avoidance/dislike common and a minority attracted to intense devotion. Too small for prevalence claims.

sources.title: Literature Review: Is the Emotional Expression of Contempt Recognized Universally or Culturally?
sources.claim_scope: The unilateral raised/tightened lip corner is often proposed as contempt, but evidence is insufficient for universal recognition; culture and context matter.

sources.title: Dispositional Contempt: A First Look at the Contemptuous Person
sources.publisher: Journal of Personality and Social Psychology
sources.claim_scope: Contempt involves evaluating another as below one's standards, distancing or derogating them, and signals strength/superiority and status imbalance; expression recognition remains unreliable.

sources.title: Does it Matter to be Pictured from Below?
sources.claim_scope: In linear picture stories, low-angle presentation increased perceived potency; the effect was context-dependent and is not proof of contempt by itself.

sources.title: Cues and Clues: How Humor Targets Classify Joker Intent
sources.claim_scope: Wink/laugh off-record markers made targeted jokes seem less aggressive and more affiliative in two experiments; useful for comic-derision intensity control, not a contempt definition.

sources.title: [모에리뷰] 매도/경멸에 관해서
sources.claim_scope: Korean fan account of soft versus hard derision, verbal versus visual delivery, status direction, and viewer-directed low-angle convention; anecdotal, sexualized in parts, and not population evidence.

sources.title: Know the Difference: A Comparison of Community-Led Erotic Knowledge Organization
sources.publisher: North American Symposium on Knowledge Organization
sources.claim_scope: Academic analysis of community tag systems. It documents an A/B/C netorare/netorase decision flow using prior relationship, awareness, consent, and instigation, and explicitly distinguishes body swap from possession.

sources.title: 中学校学習指導要領 第5章 特別活動
sources.publisher: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology, Japan
sources.claim_scope: Official framework presents student-council activity as autonomous, practical cooperation to improve school life, coordinate activities, support events, and solve problems; it does not prescribe anime-style police power.

sources.title: ヤンデレ的思考傾向と大学生活の充実の関連
sources.publisher: Japanese Society for Artificial Intelligence SIG-BI
sources.claim_scope: About 60 university students; the proposed tendency scale yielded emotional support, possessive desire, abandonment fear, and self-sacrifice factors. It studies self-reported tendencies, not fictional-audience appeal, and should not be treated as diagnosis.

sources.title: 罵倒
sources.claim_scope: Defines batou as reviling someone with harsh words; therefore readable addressed speech is necessary to establish verbal abuse rather than silent contempt.

sources.title: 軽蔑
sources.claim_scope: Defines contempt as treating someone as base, inferior, or trivial and looking down on or scorning them; it is not identical to harsh speech.

definition_and_history.claim_ko: 사전적 중심은 원래 선한 편이던 인물이 이야기 안에서 길을 벗어나 악의 편으로 이동하는 변화다.
팬 분류에서는 강제 세뇌·개조·빙의 같은 외부 원인과 절망·증오·각성·자기 선택 같은 내부 원인을 갈라 보며, 악타락과 어둠타락의 경계는 사용자마다 다르다.
단순한 검은 의상, 배신자로 밝혀짐, 일시적 분노는 이전 가치와 이후 가치의 변화가 확인되지 않으면 흑화의 충분조건이 아니다.

semantic_subtypes.definition_ko: 기존 신념의 실패나 새로운 신념의 채택 때문에 본인이 능동적으로 편을 바꾼다.
세뇌·개조·명령 장치 등 외부 행위자가 가치와 행동을 바꾼다.
저주·어둠의 힘·기생 등 지속 노출이 점진적으로 판단과 외형을 바꾼다.
외부 인격이 몸의 통제권을 얻는다. 원래 인물의 타락과 다른 인격의 점유를 구분해야 한다.
내부에 있던 욕망·인격·힘이 사건을 계기로 우세해진다.
작은 예외와 합리화가 누적되어 가치·행동 기준이 반전된다.
기억·유대·물건 같은 앵커로 잠시 되돌아오거나 회복 가능성이 드러난다.

source_supported.claim_ko: 서스펜스·놀람·호기심 구조는 서사 긴장을 만들고, 국소적 긴장은 전체 향유 평가와 양의 관계를 보였다.
source_supported.boundary: 흑화 선호 자체를 검증한 연구는 아니다.

cross_source_synthesis.synthesis_ko: 사전의 선→악 이동과 팬 기록의 전후 외형·가치 대비를 합치면, 동일 인물임을 알아볼 수 있는 표식과 반전된 행동을 동시에 보여 주는 것이 핵심 판독 단서다.
원인·주체성·가역성을 다르게 설정하면 같은 흑화 요소에서도 공포, 비극, 능동적 해방, 회복 기대라는 서로 다른 정조가 생긴다.

design_inference.inference_ko: 프롬프트는 색상 암전보다 이전 가치의 물건을 버리거나 뒤집어 사용하는 행위를 우선해야 한다.
design_inference.reason: 행동은 가치 반전을 관찰 가능하게 만들고 단순 다크 코스튬과 분리한다.

design_inference.inference_ko: 한 컷은 흔적이 있는 완료 상태에, 2컷은 전후 대비에, 3컷 이상은 원인·전이·결과에 적합하다.
design_inference.reason: 시간적 변화는 프레임 예산이 늘어날수록 직접 증명할 수 있다.

effect.prompt_delta: Show a deliberate choice and a rejected former principle; omit coercion devices.
Expose the coercive mechanism and residual resistance; do not imply consent.
Use a directional spread pattern and multiple stage markers.
Mark host and occupant separately; avoid calling the occupant's choice the host's corruption.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 회복 가능성을 단정하지 않는다.

effect.prompt_delta: Keep a former-bond anchor active and show a momentary return signal.
Show destroyed or repurposed former anchors and settled new allegiance.
Preserve incompatible simultaneous cues without resolving outcome.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 단일 컷이면 완료 직후와 이전 흔적을 함께 배치한다.

effect.frame_delta: single decisive tableau with prior-state relic

add: same adult character deliberately replacing a former faction emblem with a rival emblem
discarded oath or broken badge in foreground
steady self-possessed expression

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show the same adult character calmly removing their former faction badge and fastening a rival emblem, with the broken oath visible in the foreground and no mind-control device.
observable_evidence: same-person face, scar, or accessory persists
new allegiance receives an intentional action
narrative_evidence: choice is active rather than merely captured
old and new values are both legible
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single frame works if the discarded old token and adopted new token coexist.

add: visible external control mechanism with operator direction
residual former emblem and involuntary new salute
conflicted eye or resisting hand

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Depict an adult subject forced into a new salute by a visible external controller, while one resisting hand still grips the former emblem; make coercion, not consent, unmistakable.
narrative_evidence: low agency is explicit
the controller and subject are not conflated
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: A single frame needs mechanism, command vector, and resistance; a two-frame capture/change pair is clearer.

add: corruption spreads from a specific contact point
three readable degrees of change
same identity marker at every stage

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Create a three-stage sequence in which corruption spreads from one contact point across the same adult character, preserving one unmistakable identity marker in every stage.
narrative_evidence: cause precedes change
exposure accumulates rather than appearing as a costume swap
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Prefer three-stage strip; a single frame may use half-changed state plus contaminated source.

add: host body retaining a personal keepsake
second occupant signal such as mismatched reflection or spectral control thread
body action contradicting host's reaching hand
exclude: claim that host freely chose the new values

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show an adult host whose body obeys a second occupant, using a mismatched mirror reflection and a personal keepsake that the host still reaches for; keep host and occupant identities distinct.
narrative_evidence: occupant identity and host identity remain distinct
control status is explicit
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Mirror/reflection composition can compress two identities into one frame.

add: three escalating exceptions to a former rule
each action reuses the same prop in a more transgressive way
final rationalizing posture

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Build three connected panels where the same adult character makes increasingly serious exceptions to one former rule, reusing the same prop until the final rationalized betrayal.
observable_evidence: old rule remains visible as contrast
narrative_evidence: small choices accumulate
agency is partial and progressive
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Needs three or more beats; strongest in vertical scroll or storyboard.

add: one body with two incompatible action vectors
former keepsake gripped protectively while new insignia glows
asymmetric expression or reflection

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Compose one adult character caught between two incompatible actions, protecting an old keepsake while a new insignia activates, with an asymmetric reflection that leaves the outcome unresolved.
narrative_evidence: outcome remains unresolved
internal conflict rather than external twin confrontation
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single symbolic frame is viable; labels or captions improve identity clarity.

add: former friend, oath token, or keepsake interrupts the changed action
brief return of original eye color or gesture

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Add a former-bond keepsake that interrupts the corrupted action and briefly restores one original gesture or eye cue, without completing the recovery.
narrative_evidence: reversibility is possible but unresolved
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Use as a support beat after any corruption primary.

add: identical camera, pose family, and identity marker before and after
changed allegiance object and changed response to the same moral test
exclude: unmatched portraits with no common action

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Create a matched before-and-after diptych with identical camera and identity markers, repeating the same moral test but reversing the character's action and allegiance token.
narrative_evidence: before and after states are causally comparable
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Exactly two matched panels; not a generic collage.

add: former emblem permanently repurposed under the new faction
settled routine within the new role
no active recovery signal

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show the adult character settled into a new faction routine, with the former emblem permanently repurposed and no active recovery cue, while retaining one same-person marker.
observable_evidence: new behavior is routine rather than momentary
narrative_evidence: the image encodes completion, not the cause
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single aftermath tableau; combine with a prior-state relic.

compatible.condition: Use only when bodily transformation and value corruption are independently evidenced; one does not imply the other.
A love-driven corruption arc can combine them if the prior affectionate baseline and later controlling action are both shown.
Strong fit for cause-process-result and matched before/after.

conditional.condition: If an occupant fully replaces the host, label identity takeover rather than assuming the host's moral conversion.

conflicts.reason: Color and costume alone do not prove value change.
A person who was always aligned with the opposing side has no demonstrated fall.
Temporary emotion does not establish a persistent moral or allegiance change.

limitations.text_ko: 악타락/어둠타락의 세부 경계는 팬덤별로 다르며 사전은 세밀한 원인 분류를 제공하지 않는다.
limitations.impact: 원인·주체성·가역성을 별도 typed 축으로 저장한다.

limitations.text_ko: 팬 아카이브는 역사적 용례와 창작 관습을 보여 주지만 선호율을 대표하지 않는다.
limitations.impact: 매력 메커니즘을 보편적 심리로 단정하지 않는다.

limitations.text_ko: 정적인 한 컷은 시간 변화의 원인을 직접 증명하기 어렵다.
limitations.impact: 한 컷에서는 이전 상태의 흔적과 현재의 가치 반전 행동을 동시에 요구한다.

definition_and_history.claim_ko: 寝取る라는 동사는 타인의 배우자·연인과 관계해 자기 쪽으로 만든다는 오래된 어휘지만, NTR 장르 라벨은 2000년대 초 미소녀 게임 맥락에서 寝取られ의 축약형으로 형성되었다.
NTR 만화의 핵심 관점으로 기존 주인공/플레이어가 개입하지 못하고 지켜볼 수밖에 없는 무력성이 학술 초록에서 제시된다.
네토라레(빼앗긴 쪽), 네토리(빼앗는 쪽), 네토라세(기존 파트너가 주선·허용하는 쪽)는 서로 다른 관점과 동의 상태를 가진 팬 분류다.
BSS는 '내가 먼저 좋아했는데'의 축약으로, 기존 연인 관계의 상실이 아니라 성사되지 않은 선행 호감이 뒤늦게 다른 관계를 목격하는 관점이다.

semantic_subtypes.definition_ko: 성립된 관계의 한 당사자가 다른 인물로 관계적 우선권이 이동하는 것을 인지한다.
제3자가 이미 관계가 있는 인물의 관심·친밀성·우선권을 자기 쪽으로 이동시키는 관점이다.
기존 파트너가 제3자와의 관계를 명시적으로 주선하거나 허용한 설정이다. 동의를 화면만 보고 추정해서는 안 된다.
고백·교제가 성립되기 전의 호감을 가진 인물이 상대의 새 관계를 목격하는 관점이다.
시간·주의·신뢰의 배분이 단계적으로 기존 상대에서 제3자로 이동한다.
관계 이동 자체보다 지연된 인지, 증거 발견, 이후 반응을 중심으로 한다.

source_supported.claim_ko: 장르 연구 초록은 주인공/플레이어가 개입할 수 없고 지켜보기만 하는 무력성을 NTR 표현의 핵심으로 분석한다.
source_supported.boundary: 모든 NTR 작품이나 모든 수용자의 매력을 설명하는 보편 법칙은 아니다.

source_supported.claim_ko: 관계 위협과 자존감 위협의 강도가 질투 및 관련 감정의 가능성에 영향을 준다는 실험 결과가 있다.
source_supported.boundary: 질투 연구는 NTR 향유를 측정하지 않았다.

cross_source_synthesis.synthesis_ko: 동일한 관계 삼각형도 누가 초점 인물인지에 따라 상실, 획득, 주선, 미성립 후회로 의미가 달라진다.
관계 위협은 의심·진행·발견·후폭풍의 어느 시점에 초점을 두는지에 따라 필요한 시각 증거와 정서가 달라진다.

design_inference.inference_ko: 관계 대체를 그리려면 세 인물 배치만이 아니라 이전 관계 토큰, 현재 관심 행동, 초점 인물의 인지 반응을 함께 요구해야 한다.
design_inference.reason: 삼각 구도만으로는 연인·친구·동료·우연한 군중을 구분할 수 없다.

design_inference.inference_ko: 동의·주선·기존 관계 성립 여부는 표정으로 추정하지 말고 요청 메타데이터나 명시적 서사 단서에서만 라우팅해야 한다.
design_inference.reason: 네토라레, 네토라세, BSS의 의미를 가르는 정보가 단일 포즈에는 없다.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 관계 대체라는 상위 요소만 유지하고, 기존 파트너 관점을 기본값으로 강제하지 않는다.

effect.prompt_delta: Focus the established partner's blocked action and reaction; preserve prior-bond proof.
Center the initiator's successful redirection of attention without pretending to know the other two characters' consent.
Require explicit arrangement metadata or a legible invitation/handoff; omit betrayed-partner framing.
Show an unoffered confession or unrealized plan; do not add an established couple history.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 현재 인지가 확인되는 장면을 우선하되, 비밀·지연 발견을 임의로 추가하지 않는다.

effect.prompt_delta: Use competing attention and an uncertain prior-bond cue; avoid completed-loss symbols.
Center evidence reveal and immediate response.
Show changed relationship routine and an empty or returned prior-bond token.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 관계 토큰이 없으면 established와 unrealized를 판정하지 않는다.

effect.prompt_delta: Include an unambiguous shared-history object or ritual.
Use an unopened confession and omit couple tokens.
Render explicit cooperative planning evidence; do not signal secret betrayal.

add: established partner in focal foreground
former shared token in hand
their partner directs a once-exclusive care gesture toward a third adult
blocked reach or frozen response

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Frame the established adult partner in the foreground holding a shared-history token while their partner redirects a once-exclusive care gesture toward a third adult; show the focal person's blocked reach.
observable_evidence: displaced partner's awareness and inability to intervene
narrative_evidence: an established relationship preceded the displacement
loss is perceived from the displaced viewpoint
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single frame requires all three roles plus old/new relationship evidence.

add: third adult actively wins the central person's time or trust through a specific shared task
previous partner's interrupted ritual remains visible
initiator controls the action vector

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Center a third adult who wins the central person's time through a concrete shared task, while the previous partner's interrupted ritual remains visible at the edge; do not add coercion or villain coding.
narrative_evidence: viewpoint is acquisition rather than only loss
prior relationship still exists in scene history
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Over-shoulder or central-initiator framing; displaced reaction can be peripheral support.

add: three adults consulting an agreed plan or invitation
existing partner makes a clear handoff gesture
calm reciprocal acknowledgment

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show three adults openly consulting an agreed invitation, with the existing partner making a clear handoff gesture and all parties acknowledging the plan; avoid secret-discovery staging.
narrative_evidence: arrangement is stated in metadata or readable action
loss is not assumed
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single frame is possible only with an explicit planning object or caption; otherwise use a setup panel.

add: adult admirer holding an unopened confession or unoffered gift
the admired person beginning a new reciprocal ritual with someone else
no evidence of a prior couple between admirer and admired
exclude: wedding ring or couple token linking admirer and admired

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Place an adult admirer in the foreground with an unopened confession while the admired person begins a reciprocal ritual with someone else; include no prior-couple token between admirer and admired.
narrative_evidence: affection preceded the new relationship but was never established
regret is distinct from partner loss
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single frame works with a foreground unoffered token and background new pair.

add: same recurring shared routine across three beats
time, eye contact, or entrusted object moves from prior partner to third adult
displaced reaction escalates only after the shift is visible

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Use three connected beats of the same routine, progressively moving eye contact, time, and an entrusted object from the prior partner to a third adult before showing the displaced reaction.
narrative_evidence: bond displacement occurs over time
viewpoint can be routed separately
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Prefer three-panel strip or vertical scroll.

add: focal adult encounters a concrete relationship-displacement trace
their old shared token appears reassigned or returned
immediate frozen or withdrawn response

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show the focal adult discovering a concrete displacement trace—such as their shared token reassigned to someone else—with an immediate frozen response and no generic surveillance shorthand.
narrative_evidence: awareness is delayed until this beat
the scene depicts discovery rather than the whole relationship history
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Close foreground evidence plus reflected or background relationship can compress the reveal.

add: competing bids for the same person's attention
prior partner notices a familiar ritual shared with a third adult
no completed break marker

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Compose an unresolved adult relationship threat: two competing bids for one person's attention, a familiar ritual repeated with a third adult, and no completed-break marker.
narrative_evidence: relationship threat exists but outcome remains open
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: One frame can sustain ambiguity; do not add epilogue evidence.

add: former partner alone at a once-shared routine
one place empty or shared object returned
distant evidence of the new routine without voyeuristic detail

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show the former adult partner alone at a once-shared routine, with one place empty and a returned token nearby; keep the new relationship only as distant contextual evidence.
narrative_evidence: loss has already been realized
attention rests on consequence
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Negative space is a primary compositional device.

add: unique shared-history object, repeated ritual, paired reservation, or mutually recognized promise
exclude: generic matching colors as sole proof

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Add one unmistakable prior-bond anchor—a unique shared object, paired reservation, or repeated ritual—and make its ownership and history readable.
observable_evidence: token ownership and prior pairing are legible
narrative_evidence: established relationship is supported rather than assumed
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Use foreground insert or repeated across panels.

compatible.condition: Best for separating prior bond, displacement, awareness, and aftermath.
Only when obsession is a separately requested reaction or cause; do not infer it from jealousy.
A rival or displaced partner may show contempt, but the relationship change still needs independent evidence.

conditional.condition: Requires explicit arrangement/consent metadata; a calm face alone is insufficient.
Must exclude an established prior couple between admirer and admired.

conflicts.reason: Three people and crossed gazes do not establish prior relationship, displacement, or viewpoint.
The term family includes multiple genders, viewpoints, consent states, and relationship stages.
Consent and arrangement cannot be reliably read from smiling, blushing, or passivity.

limitations.text_ko: NTR는 성인 매체에서 발달한 용어지만 관계 대체라는 문법은 비명시적 일상 장면으로도 연구 가능하다.
limitations.impact: 후보는 관계 토큰·주의 이동·반응을 중심으로 구성하고 특정 성행위를 정의 증거로 삼지 않는다.

limitations.text_ko: 네토리·네토라세 세분은 주로 팬 글로서 표준화가 약하다.
limitations.impact: viewpoint, prior_relationship, arrangement, awareness, loss_status를 독립 필드로 유지한다.

limitations.text_ko: 질투 연구는 장르 향유를 입증하지 않는다.
limitations.impact: 관계 위협은 source-supported 감정 메커니즘으로만 기록하고 선호 이유는 합성 또는 추론으로 표시한다.

limitations.text_ko: 한 컷은 과거 관계와 동의 상태를 자명하게 보여 주기 어렵다.
limitations.impact: 명시 메타데이터가 없으면 established, arranged, betrayal을 자동 확정하지 않는다.

research_questions: Which specific adult counterpart is being provoked, and what prior event makes the provocation legible?
How does the scene distinguish status inversion from generic smugness or sass?
Is the delivery verbal, facial, spatial, competitive, or care-through-insult?
Does confidence persist, reverse into embarrassment, or reveal a caring action gap?

definition_and_history.claim_ko: 이 표현은 속어·비어로 분류되며 단순한 sassy, 장난꾸러기, 츤데레와 동의어가 아니다.
2025년 법정대 논문은 단어의 이른 사용례를 1982년 『우루세이 야츠라』 단행본까지 추적하고, 현대적 표현의 중심을 생의기한 언행, 반복 모욕, 상대를 내려다보는 태도와 수동적 상대의 관계에서 찾는다.
1982년 사례는 단어의 이른 사용례이지 오늘날의 전체 아키타입이 그때 완성되었다는 증거가 아니다.
팬 기록에는 표적 도발, 귀엽게 조절된 강도, 자신감 뒤의 역당황, 험한 말과 돌봄 행동의 갭이 서로 다른 변형으로 나타난다.

semantic_subtypes.definition_ko: 특정 상대의 직전 실수·지위·승부 결과를 겨냥한 짧은 도발이다.
말 대신 시선·턱·손짓·거리와 상대 반응으로 도발 관계를 만든다.
게임·훈련·과제의 가시적 결과를 근거로 우위를 과시한다.
공식 지위는 낮은 성인 후배가 거리·시선·행동 벡터를 장악해 상대의 반응을 끌어낸다.
도발 당시의 자신감이 예상 밖의 반응이나 결과로 무너지는 전환을 중심으로 한다.
말은 도발적이지만 행동은 상대의 필요에 맞춘 유능한 돌봄이다.

source_supported.claim_ko: 법정대 논문은 도발자와 수동적 상대 사이의 내려다봄·생의기함·반복 모욕이라는 관계 구조를 분석한다.
source_supported.boundary: 수용자 선호의 크기나 보편성을 측정한 연구는 아니다.

source_supported.claim_ko: 일반 teasing 연구에서는 윙크와 웃음 같은 off-record 표식이 표적 농담을 덜 공격적이고 더 친화적으로 평가하게 했다.
source_supported.boundary: 메스가키 장르를 직접 실험한 결과는 아니다.

cross_source_synthesis.synthesis_ko: 공식 역할상 낮은 위치의 성인 후배가 장면의 시선·행동·반응을 장악할 때 위계 역전이 읽힌다.
도발의 표적성과 결과는 유지하되 웃음·윙크·과장 같은 유희 표식을 넣으면 가벼운 장난 변형으로, 제거하면 날카로운 도발 변형으로 라우팅할 수 있다.

design_inference.inference_ko: 단일 컷의 최소 사슬은 특정 상대/결과→표적 도발→상대 반응이다.
design_inference.reason: 반쯤 감긴 눈과 웃음만으로는 일반 smugness와 구분되지 않는다.

design_inference.inference_ko: 이미지 후보는 성인 후배·주니어 동료 같은 명시적 역할 문맥을 사용하고 작은 체형만으로 나이·지위를 추정하지 않는다.
design_inference.reason: 원어는 젠더화되고 연령 표지가 있는 비어이므로 시각적 외형 태그만으로 안전하거나 정확한 의미를 만들 수 없다. 이는 분류 경계이며 정책 변경이 아니다.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 텍스트 렌더링을 강제하지 않는 표정·행동 후보를 우선하되 상대와 결과를 유지한다.

effect.prompt_delta: Use a short addressed balloon or caption tied to the counterpart's visible result.
Replace text with gaze, chin angle, gesture, and counterpart reaction.
Use adult-to-adult proxemics and blocked retreat, not body-size coding.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 가벼운 장난 표식을 하나 넣고 굴욕적 결과를 임의로 추가하지 않는다.

effect.prompt_delta: Add a reassuring wink, shared laugh, or reversible game stake.
Remove affiliative markers and make the target-specific consequence clearer.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 도발 직후의 우세를 유지하고 후속 역전을 자동 추가하지 않는다.

effect.prompt_delta: Keep the provocateur composed and the counterpart reacting.
Pair a mild addressed jab with a need-matched completed care action.

add: adult junior colleague addresses one adult counterpart
short taunt references the counterpart's visible mistake
counterpart pauses or flushes
junior controls eye-line

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show an adult junior colleague teasing one specific adult counterpart about a visible mistake, with a short readable speech balloon, direct eye-line, and the counterpart pausing in embarrassed recognition.
narrative_evidence: the insult is targeted rather than generic
lower formal rank holds momentary scene control
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: One frame works when balloon tail, result prop, and reaction remain legible.

add: adult junior points at a completed result
slightly raised chin and asymmetric smile aimed at an adult senior
senior's interrupted hand confirms the target

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Create a silent adult-to-adult challenge: the junior points to the finished result with a raised chin and asymmetric smile while the senior's interrupted hand reveals who is being teased.
narrative_evidence: the expression has a target and cause
status inversion is contextual
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single frame, medium two-shot; avoid portrait crop that removes the target.

add: role badge shows junior status
junior occupies the action apex and blocks the senior's next move
senior yields visual focus despite higher formal rank

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Stage an adult junior with a clear role badge at the action apex, calmly blocking the higher-ranked adult's next move so formal rank and momentary control visibly diverge.
narrative_evidence: formal hierarchy and scene control point in opposite directions
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Use triangular blocking and eye-lines; camera height alone is insufficient.

add: adult competitors at a finished board game, training drill, or repair challenge
junior taps the score/result
playful wink or laugh
counterpart accepts the result

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show two adult competitors after a finished game or workshop challenge; the junior taps the winning result with a playful wink while the counterpart visibly accepts the loss.
narrative_evidence: provocation follows a concrete outcome
playful intensity is marked
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single-frame game-table or workshop two-shot.

add: adult junior leans into the adult senior's conversational space
one hand pins the relevant checklist or score rather than the person
senior leans back and keeps gaze on junior

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Bring an adult junior close to an adult senior while pinning the relevant checklist or score to the wall—not the person—and show the senior leaning back under the junior's direct gaze.
narrative_evidence: pressure is social and targeted
the prop explains the provocation
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Tight two-shot; preserve hands and explanatory prop.

add: panel one: adult junior confidently provokes
panel two: senior responds unexpectedly but benignly
same camera and props
junior's gaze breaks and posture contracts

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Make a matched two-panel beat: first, an adult junior confidently teases the senior; second, the senior gives an unexpected benign reply, causing the junior's gaze to break and posture to contract.
narrative_evidence: the reversal is caused by the counterpart's response
no unrelated comeuppance is added
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Two matched panels are strongly preferred.

add: adult junior delivers a mild targeted jab
simultaneously repairs the senior's torn strap or hands over prepared medicine
senior's need is visibly resolved
playful off-record marker
exclude: care inferred from affectionate pose alone

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show an adult junior making a mild teasing remark while competently repairing the senior's torn strap or handing over prepared medicine; the completed care result must contradict the abrasive words.
narrative_evidence: words and actions diverge
care is practical rather than assumed affection
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single frame works if speech and repaired result are both readable; two beats improve the gap.

add: one visible failed move, wrong assembly, lost score, or corrected checklist
counterpart's hand remains connected to that result

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Add one clear result anchor—a failed move, wrong assembly, lost score, or corrected checklist—and keep the counterpart's hand or gaze connected to it.
narrative_evidence: the provocation has a concrete occasion
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Foreground insert or central tabletop prop.

compatible.condition: Use abrasive-caretaker gap only when a real need, care action, and completion trace are also shown.
Shared facial or status cues are possible, but playful provocation and genuine contempt must remain distinct intensity states.
Useful for repeated taunts or confidence-to-embarrassment reversal.

conditional.condition: Required for exact verbal style; text-free images should use the nonverbal subtype.

conflicts.reason: No target, occasion, status inversion, or reaction is established.
Hidden affection or later softening is not required by the lexical archetype.
Scale alone cannot establish adulthood, junior role, or hierarchy.

limitations.text_ko: 원어는 젠더화되고 연령 표지가 있는 비어이며 에로틱한 장르 계보도 갖는다.
limitations.impact: 프롬프트에서는 명시적 성인 역할·관계와 행동 증거를 사용하며 외형만으로 문자적 아키타입을 주장하지 않는다.

limitations.text_ko: 법정대 논문은 텍스트·주체 분석이지 선호 실험이 아니다.
limitations.impact: 매력 메커니즘의 보편성은 주장하지 않는다.

limitations.text_ko: 정확한 말투와 반복 도발은 이미지 한 컷만으로 증명하기 어렵다.
limitations.impact: 대사 요구 시 텍스트 형식으로, 그렇지 않으면 관계적 비언어 후보로 라우팅한다.

research_questions: What visible need or cue triggers the care action, and what result proves that it was responsive?
Is the requested mode indulgent warmth, practical structured care, recovery support, or emotional acceptance?
Is maternal coding literal kinship, an unexpected-caregiver role reversal, or a fandom term such as babumi?
Can a single frame prove only one care episode, or does the request require repeated reliability over time?

definition_and_history.claim_ko: HAI 2018 논문은 바부미를 2014~2015년 무렵의 인터넷 슬랭으로 설명하며, 좁게는 예상 밖으로 연하인 여성에게서 느끼는 모성, 넓게는 남성·인외 등 예상 밖 존재의 모성적 돌봄까지 포함할 수 있다고 기록한다.
같은 논문은 응석을 받아주는 따뜻함과 깨우기·챙기기 같은 실무적 돌봄을 유용하게 구분한다.
2018년 Pixiv 태그 627건 표본에서 무릎베개·포옹·수유 등이 직접 표지로 나타났지만, 캐릭터명만 붙은 이미지와 만화가 많아 단일 컷의 이유는 불명확한 경우가 많았다.
ORICON은 '대상에게서 모성을 느껴 응석부리고 싶다'와 '대상이 아기 같아 돌봐주고 싶다'라는 반대 방향 용법이 공존한다고 기록한다. 두 방향은 자동 병합하면 안 된다.

semantic_subtypes.definition_ko: 포옹·무릎베개·담요·부드러운 깨우기처럼 긴장을 낮추고 의존을 받아주는 돌봄이다.
식사·약·일정·정돈·수선처럼 필요를 예측하고 해결하는 구체적 행동이다.
피로·비·가벼운 부상·과로 뒤의 체온·수분·휴식을 회복시키는 행동이다.
상대의 실패·불안·울음을 바로 해결하려 하지 않고 듣고 받아주는 돌봄이다.
상대가 말하기 전에 반복되는 필요를 예측해 준비한다.
평소 돌봄을 받을 것 같던 성인 후배·작은 로봇·비인간 존재 등이 능숙한 돌봄자가 된다.
과잉 간섭이 아니라 필요한 휴식·약속·한계를 분명히 하면서 실질적 도움을 준다.

source_supported.claim_ko: HAI 논문은 모성적 인상을 따뜻함·배려·신뢰와 실무적 챙김의 두 방향으로 정리하고, 간섭이 과하면 부정적으로 받아들여질 수 있다고 논의한다.
source_supported.boundary: 소규모 로봇 실험과 한 시점 태그 표본이므로 보편적 선호 순위는 아니다.

cross_source_synthesis.synthesis_ko: 예상 밖 역할의 인물이 정확한 필요에 유능하게 반응하면 역할 역전과 안정감이 동시에 읽힌다.
필요 신호→그 필요에 맞는 행동→수용·완료 결과가 연결될 때 일반적인 다정한 포즈보다 돌봄 관계가 분명해진다.

design_inference.inference_ko: 앞치마·성숙한 외모·머리 모양만으로 어머니·가족관계를 추정하지 않는다.
design_inference.reason: 모성적 돌봄은 생물학적 친족과 분리된 팬 용례를 갖고 외형은 행동을 증명하지 못한다.

design_inference.inference_ko: 한 컷은 한 번의 반응적 돌봄만 증명하며 지속적 신뢰성은 반복 프레임이나 명시 메타데이터가 필요하다.
design_inference.reason: 안정된 역할 관계는 시간 축 정보다.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 실무 행동과 따뜻한 반응을 한 번씩 결합하되 과잉 간섭은 추가하지 않는다.

effect.prompt_delta: Prioritize soft support posture, recipient relaxation, and accepted contact.
Show a need-specific task and completed result rather than an embrace.
Use listening posture, unhurried proximity, and recipient release; omit quick-fix props.
Pair a clear limit with concrete help and preserve the recipient's agency.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 가벼운 피로와 일상적 준비 부족처럼 읽기 쉬운 비극적이지 않은 필요를 선택한다.
친족 호칭을 붙이지 않고 현재 행동으로 돌봄 역할을 보여 준다.

effect.prompt_delta: Make formal roles explicit and let care competence reverse the expected direction.

add: adult recipient is late and missing essentials
adult caregiver has breakfast, transit card, and packed bag ready
recipient accepts items and relaxes

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show one adult rushing through the morning while another has breakfast, transit card, and packed bag ready; the recipient accepts the items and visibly relaxes.
narrative_evidence: care anticipates a recurring need
relationship is caregiving without implied kinship
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single domestic or shared-office frame with clear prop handoff.

add: adult recipient arrives rain-soaked or exhausted
caregiver wraps a dry blanket and offers a warm drink
wet gear is set aside and shoulders release

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Depict an exhausted rain-soaked adult being wrapped in a dry blanket and handed a warm drink, with wet gear set aside and the recipient's shoulders visibly releasing.
narrative_evidence: the action matches the current need
care is accepted
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single close two-shot with wet/dry state contrast.

add: adult recipient holds evidence of a failed effort
caregiver listens at eye level without interrupting
open hand offered but contact waits for acceptance
recipient posture loosens

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show an adult holding evidence of a failed effort while another adult listens at eye level, offering an open hand without forcing contact; let the recipient's posture slowly loosen.
narrative_evidence: emotion is accepted before being fixed
recipient agency remains visible
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Quiet eye-level two-shot; negative space supports unhurried attention.

add: adult recipient resting with head on adult caregiver's lap
gentle wake-up gesture
soft morning cue
recipient wakes calmly

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Illustrate one adult waking calmly with their head on another adult's lap, guided by a gentle wake-up gesture and soft morning light; do not imply biological kinship.
narrative_evidence: indulgent comfort is the active care mode
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single intimate two-shot; keep both adult identities and wake action visible.

add: adult caregiver arranges labeled meal, water, and ordinary scheduled medicine
adult recipient reaches for the correct item
calendar/checklist shows completion

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show an adult caregiver arranging a labeled meal, water, and ordinary scheduled medicine while the adult recipient takes the correct item and marks the routine complete.
narrative_evidence: care is structured and repeatable
no diagnosis is inferred
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Top-down tabletop plus two-person interaction; text labels should remain short.

add: adult recipient's bag strap or costume fastener is visibly broken
caregiver repairs it and repacks missing tools
repaired seam and ready bag are shown
exclude: caregiver posing with tools but no result

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show an adult caregiver repairing the recipient's broken bag strap and repacking the missing tools, with the repaired seam and ready-to-use bag clearly visible.
narrative_evidence: care solves a specific functional need
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single frame can show before trace and completed repair together.

add: explicit role markers establish an adult junior or small service robot as normally assisted
that figure now competently cares for an exhausted adult senior
need-action-result chain remains complete

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Use clear role markers to establish an adult junior or small service robot as the unexpected caregiver, then show them competently tending an exhausted adult senior through a complete need-action-result chain.
narrative_evidence: care reverses the expected role direction
competence, not appearance, carries the meaning
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Two-shot with role props and outcome; one setup inset may clarify expectation.

add: adult caregiver closes the overwork laptop or removes one task
places water and a revised schedule within reach
recipient agrees and chooses the next step

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show an adult caregiver firmly closing an overwork laptop, placing water and a revised schedule nearby, while the adult recipient agrees and chooses the next step.
narrative_evidence: firmness serves care
recipient agency is preserved
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single medium two-shot with hands and schedule visible.

add: one visible need cue
one contingent care action
one accepted, redirected, or completed result
exclude: apron or mature appearance as sole care cue

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Add a compact care chain: one visible need cue, one action tailored to that need, and one accepted or completed result; do not rely on an apron or mature appearance alone.
narrative_evidence: care is responsive rather than decorative
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Reusable support atom across single- and multi-frame candidates.

compatible.condition: Abrasive-caretaker gap requires mild targeted words plus independently readable care action and result.
Strong fit when need state, practical action, and relaxation are visible.
Use explicit role markers; do not infer age or kinship from appearance.

conditional.condition: Contact should be clearly accepted or offered; otherwise choose practical non-contact care.

conflicts.reason: Costume alone proves neither maternal feeling nor care action.
Babumi and fandom 'mama' can describe non-kin care.
Wanting to care for a baby-like target is the opposite care direction from wanting care from the target.

limitations.text_ko: HAI 연구의 Pixiv 표본은 2018년 한 시점이고 실험 참가자 수도 작다.
limitations.impact: 무릎베개 등을 보편적 선호 순위로 취급하지 않는다.

limitations.text_ko: 마망·바부미·mommy는 언어권과 화자에 따라 돌봄 방향이 달라진다.
limitations.impact: caregiver, recipient, need, direction을 별도 필드로 둔다.

limitations.text_ko: 한 번의 다정한 포즈는 안정기지나 지속적 신뢰를 증명하지 않는다.
limitations.impact: 단일 컷은 현재 에피소드로 한정하고 장기 관계는 연속 장면이나 메타데이터로만 확정한다.

research_questions: Which concrete school-life duty is being performed, and what result proves the role?
Does the request refer to real committee practice or an exaggerated fiction convention?
Which role marker and rule prop identify the committee without relying on an armband alone?
Is the requested contrast strict control, service-oriented competence, or a composure-break gap?

definition_and_history.claim_ko: 2025년 오차노미즈대 부속중학교의 실제 풍기위원회는 분실물 관리, 자유복 기간 교장 체크, 인사 활성화, ICT·온라인 단말 관리 등을 맡는다.
문부과학성의 중학교 특별활동 지침은 생徒회 활동을 더 나은 학교생활, 문제 해결, 행사 협력, 활동 조정을 위한 자주적·실천적 협력으로 둔다.
리쓰메이칸 사료는 1948년 한 학교에서 풍기위원회가 교사의 일상 학생관리 규칙을 보조했다고 기록한다. 이는 전국적 기원 증거가 아니라 단일 학교의 역사 사례다.
팬 기록은 실제의 제한된 학생 자치·지원 역할과 창작물의 과장된 경찰권, 정돈된 복장·완장, 엄격함이 당황으로 무너지는 갭을 구분한다.

semantic_subtypes.definition_ko: 등교 동선에서 학생 표식이나 합의된 복장 규칙을 확인하고 결과를 기록한다.
분실물을 분류·기록하고 소유자에게 돌려주는 서비스 업무다.
행사나 학교생활 개선을 위해 인사·예절 캠페인을 운영한다.
공용 단말 대여·반납·충전·기록을 관리한다.
학교 행사에서 줄·안내·장비·개폐회 진행을 협력적으로 정리한다.
규칙을 지적하는 데서 끝나지 않고 당사자가 준수할 수 있도록 실제 해결을 돕는다.
완장·클립보드·교문·순찰 같은 관습으로 실제보다 강한 통제 권한을 연출한다.
정확한 절차를 집행하던 위원이 자신의 작은 실수나 예상 밖 상황에서 침착함을 잃는다.

source_supported.claim_ko: 공식 학교 자료는 풍기위원 역할이 분실물·교장·인사·ICT 같은 구체적 생활 업무임을 보여 준다.
source_supported.boundary: 캐릭터 매력이나 전국 공통 직무를 입증하는 자료는 아니다.

source_supported.claim_ko: 문부과학성 지침은 학생 활동의 자주성·실천성·협력적 문제 해결을 강조한다.
source_supported.boundary: 특정 풍기위원 아키타입의 선호 연구가 아니다.

cross_source_synthesis.synthesis_ko: 역할 표식+구체적 업무 소품+처리 결과를 함께 보여 주면 완장만 찬 일반 학생과 구별된다.
절차 통제 능력과 사적인 당황을 연속해서 보여 주면 능력과 취약성의 대비가 생긴다.

design_inference.inference_ko: 기본 후보는 실제 업무를 우선하고 과장된 경찰권은 사용자가 창작 관습을 요청했을 때만 선택한다.
design_inference.reason: 현실 역할과 팬 관습의 근거 강도가 다르다.

design_inference.inference_ko: 클립보드나 완장은 보조 표식이며 반환된 물건, 기록된 확인, 정리된 동선 같은 결과가 필요하다.
design_inference.reason: 소품 보유와 실제 역할 수행을 구분한다.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 현재 공식 사례가 있는 분실물 또는 교장 확인 후보를 우선한다.
서비스 지향 절차 역할을 기본으로 하고 초법적 권한을 추가하지 않는다.

effect.prompt_delta: Show cooperative explanation and a completed service result.
Use checklist-based procedure and even-handed application.
Add overt fiction framing and visible limits; do not present it as real-school fact.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 업무 능력을 유지하고 당황 갭을 자동 추가하지 않는다.

add: school entrance
adult-coded or clearly senior students in context
committee member checks school badge against a short checklist
checked student corrects or confirms badge
recorded result

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: At a school entrance, show a committee member checking a visible school badge against a short checklist, while the other clearly senior student corrects it and the completed check is recorded.
narrative_evidence: limited procedural duty
cooperative compliance rather than police power
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single medium two-shot; keep badge and checklist readable.

add: labeled lost-property shelves
committee member matches a logged description
owner identifies a unique mark
item is returned and record closed

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show a committee member matching a logged description to an item on labeled lost-property shelves, then returning it after the owner identifies a unique mark and closing the record.
narrative_evidence: service result completes the duty
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single counter scene or two-step return panel.

add: student-made greeting campaign board
committee members invite peers rather than command them
visible participation marks or completed pledge cards

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Depict a student-led greeting campaign with a handmade board, committee members inviting peers to participate, and visible completed pledge cards rather than punitive enforcement.
narrative_evidence: school-life improvement through cooperation
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Wider group frame; primary committee member remains focal through action.

add: numbered school tablets and charging rack
committee member scans return entry
peer hands over device
status changes to returned or charging

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show a committee member receiving a numbered school tablet, scanning its return entry, and placing it in the charging rack as the status visibly changes to returned.
narrative_evidence: ICT stewardship, not generic technical hobby
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single counter/tabletop frame.

add: school festival route map
committee member redirects a queue around a blocked corridor
signage is updated
flow resumes

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: During a school festival, show a committee member using a route map to redirect a queue around a blocked corridor, updating the sign and restoring the flow.
narrative_evidence: coordination solves a shared event problem
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Wide frame or two panels for blockage and resolution.

add: committee member points out one concrete rule issue
immediately provides a spare badge, tape, or correct form
peer fixes the issue
checklist closes

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show a committee member identifying one concrete rule issue, offering the spare badge or correct form needed to fix it, and closing the checklist after the peer resolves it.
narrative_evidence: authority is paired with practical support
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single medium two-shot with before trace and resolved state.

add: two peers dispute a shared space or schedule
committee member places the written rule and both claims side by side
revised fair schedule receives both check marks
exclude: unilateral verdict without hearing both sides

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Show a committee member mediating two peers' schedule conflict by placing the written rule and both claims side by side, then producing a revised fair schedule that both approve.
narrative_evidence: procedure resolves a shared problem
authority is bounded and even-handed
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Three-person tabletop triangle; one panel can work with clear documents.

add: overt anime-style school setting
armband plus route checklist and one specific minor rule
committee member patrols with theatrical authority
peer response remains comedic

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: In an overtly stylized anime-school scene, give the committee member an armband, route checklist, and one minor rule to patrol theatrically, with a clearly comedic peer reaction and visible limits on authority.
narrative_evidence: exaggerated convention is labeled as fiction
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Dynamic hallway wide shot; prop and rule must stay legible.

add: panel one: immaculate committee procedure
panel two: committee member notices their own tiny checklist or badge mistake
same setting and role props
contained fluster rather than total incompetence

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Create a matched diptych: first, the committee member performs an immaculate check; second, they notice their own tiny badge or checklist mistake and become briefly flustered without losing competence.
narrative_evidence: vulnerability follows demonstrated competence
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Two matched panels; one frame weakens the temporal contrast.

compatible.condition: Concrete duty, role marker, and completed result create a grounded episode.
Strict facial cues may coexist, but contempt requires separate inferiority/dismissal evidence.
A junior may tease the committee member only if the original duty remains primary or is explicitly made support.

conditional.condition: Use only with overt fiction framing and a bounded rule target.

conflicts.reason: An armband without a duty, rule prop, or outcome is costume shorthand, not role evidence.
School operations leadership and morals-committee life duties are not automatically the same role.
Official and school primary sources describe cooperative, bounded student activities rather than police-equivalent power.

limitations.text_ko: 풍기위원의 실제 명칭과 직무는 학교별로 다르다.
limitations.impact: 오차노미즈 사례를 전국 표준으로 일반화하지 않는다.

limitations.text_ko: 1948년 리쓰메이칸 기록은 한 학교의 전후사다.
limitations.impact: 전국적 기원 연도라고 주장하지 않는다.

limitations.text_ko: 완장·과장된 권력·감정 붕괴는 팬 관습 근거다.
limitations.impact: 실제 직무와 fiction_convention을 별도 subtype과 provenance로 유지한다.

research_questions: What transformation mechanism is requested: same-person bodily change, reciprocal swap, possession, mind transfer, or reincarnation?
Which identity anchor persists, and does the body, mind, memory, or agency carry continuity?
Is the transformation beginning, in progress, complete, temporary, reversible, or permanent?
Is the focal viewpoint the transformed subject, the other participant, or an onlooker discovering the change?

definition_and_history.claim_ko: pixivision은 일본 웹 용례의 TSF를 Trans Sexual Fiction/Fantasy의 약자로 소개하며, 같은 인물의 신체 변화뿐 아니라 남녀 몸바꿈, 빙의, 뇌이식까지 포함하는 상위 창작 범주로 설명한다.
같은 글은 TSF·여체화·남체화의 태그 경계가 완전히 고정되어 있지 않으며 작성자 선택에 따라 달라질 수 있다고 명시한다.
지식조직 연구는 커뮤니티 태그에서 body swap을 다른 참가자와 몸을 바꾸는 것으로 정의하고 possession과 혼동하지 말라는 경계를 확인한다.
Transformative Works and Cultures 논문은 genderswap 라벨이 신체·성별·젠더 정체성의 복잡성을 축소할 수 있으며 현실의 트랜스젠더 정체성과 하나로 취급해서는 안 된다고 논한다.

semantic_subtypes.definition_ko: 마음·기억·행위 주체는 연속된 채 한 인물의 신체 상태가 바뀐다.
두 인물의 마음·기억이 서로의 몸으로 교환된다.
한 인격이 다른 몸을 점유하며 host와 occupant의 통제 상태가 핵심이다.
기술적 장치나 이식으로 기억·의식이 다른 몸 또는 합성체로 이동한다.
죽음·재생 또는 세계 이동 뒤 기억·습관 일부를 지닌 새 몸으로 이어진다.
시간·조건·도구에 따라 원상 복귀하는 변환이다.
변환 완료 뒤 새 신체·역할에 적응하는 일상과 정체성 연속을 중심으로 한다.

source_supported.claim_ko: 학술 지식조직 연구는 body swap과 possession 같은 팬 태그의 세분을 보존하는 것이 사용자 의미를 지우지 않는다고 논한다.
source_supported.boundary: 이것은 분류 가치의 근거이지 시각적 매력의 실험이 아니다.

source_supported.claim_ko: TWC 연구는 신체 변화 라벨만으로 젠더 정체성의 복잡성을 축소할 수 있음을 보여 준다.

cross_source_synthesis.synthesis_ko: 눈에 띄는 신체 변화와 변하지 않은 기억·습관·개인 소품을 함께 두면 변화와 동일 인물성의 긴장이 읽힌다.
당사자 시점은 감각·행위 적응을, 상대 참가자 시점은 정체 교차를, 주변인 시점은 발견과 검증을 강조한다.

design_inference.inference_ko: TSF 상위 라벨을 그대로 프롬프트에 던지지 말고 mechanism, stage, permanence, identity_carrier, viewpoint를 먼저 선택한다.
design_inference.reason: 상위 범주는 서로 다른 참가자 수와 정체 연속 구조를 포함한다.

design_inference.inference_ko: 동일 인물 표식+변화 방향+원인 또는 단계 표식이 없으면 단순 캐릭터 재디자인과 구분하기 어렵다.
design_inference.reason: 정적 결과만으로 변환 사건을 증명할 수 없다.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 동일 인물의 비성적 마법 변환을 중립 후보로 두고 swap·possession을 임의 선택하지 않는다.

effect.prompt_delta: Require two bodies, two identities, and reciprocal cross-mapped habits.
Track host, occupant, and control status; do not label it a swap.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 완료 직전의 변화와 동일 인물 표식을 한 컷에 압축한다.

effect.prompt_delta: Show catalyst contact and first directional change.
Use old identity anchor and current-body action.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 가역성을 단정하지 않는다.

effect.prompt_delta: Keep causal and recovery status unresolved while preserving identity evidence.

preference_axes.unspecified_behavior: 변환 당사자를 초점으로 두고 주변 반응은 지원 역할로 제한한다.

effect.prompt_delta: Center embodied self-check and familiar habit.
Use paired reciprocal cross-mapping.
Give the onlooker a recognition test tied to a private identity token.

add: same adult character in three matched stages
one personal accessory and habitual gesture persist
body silhouette and clothing fit change directionally
cause remains visible

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Create three matched stages of the same adult character undergoing a bodily transformation, preserving one personal accessory and habitual gesture while silhouette and clothing fit change from a visible catalyst.
narrative_evidence: same mind and memory continue through the change
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Three-panel strip or transformation sheet.

add: adult subject touches a specific magical catalyst
transformation boundary moves across the body
old identity accessory crosses the boundary unchanged
self-recognition reaction

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Capture an adult touching a magical catalyst as a visible transformation boundary moves across the body, leaving one identity accessory unchanged while the subject recognizes the change.

personal accessories are held by the mind owner rather than body owner
mirrored surprise and mutual recognition

control state is labeled or visibly contested

possession is not reciprocal exchange
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Mirror or shadow composition compresses two identities into one frame.

source state and destination awakening are distinct

bodily identity is discontinuous
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single reveal tableau or before-life/after-life diptych.

original identity token remains ready
current task must be completed before reversion

definition_and_history.claim_ko: 罵倒는 격한 말로 상대를 심하게 욕하는 행위이므로 언어적 매도는 읽을 수 있는 발화와 지향 대상이 필요하다.

한쪽 입꼬리 상승은 흔한 경멸 표정 후보지만 문화권과 맥락을 가로질러 보편적으로 인식된다는 증거는 불충분하다.

대상 POV의 낮은 카메라와 위에서 내려다보는 행동을 보조적으로 사용해 우위를 강화한다.
과장된 흉내·웃음·윙크 등 유희 표식으로 공격성을 낮춘 조롱이다.

candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Single ensemble two-shot; preserve both laughter and target engagement.

narrative_evidence: audience participation turns derision into public down-ranking
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Wide group composition; target, speaker, and audience form distinct roles.

candidate_realizations.prompt_operation_en: Add one spatially clear adult target, one context cue, one action-linked reaction, and one status or distance consequence; never rely on an isolated facial expression.
narrative_evidence: contempt or teasing is interpreted relationally
candidate_realizations.frame_implications: Reusable support bundle; target must remain in frame or be represented by hands/POV.

compatible.condition: Shared taunt cues are allowed, but playful status inversion and genuine inferiority appraisal must be routed by intensity markers.
A strict committee member may show contempt only if target, context, distancing, and reaction independently support it.
Derision can be a reaction or rival action; prior relationship displacement still needs its own evidence.

conditional.condition: Use only as potency support after contempt or dismissal is established.
Affiliative off-record markers and reversible stakes must be visible.

conflicts.reason: Facial contempt recognition is culturally and contextually unreliable.
Verbal abuse requires harsh language; silent scenes belong to nonverbal contempt or dismissal.
Camera angle can increase perceived potency but does not identify contempt.
